CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY.description: Tool to retrieve sent SMS message history with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to view previously sent SMS messages or check delivery status.

q.description: Custom query string for filtering results. Format: field:value pairs separated by commas. Example: 'from:+61411111111,status_code:201' or 'status:Sent'. Searchable fields: status (Queued, Completed, Scheduled, WaitApproval, Failed, Cancelled, CancelledAfterReview, Received, Sent), to (recipient phone number). Searches are case-insensitive.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Used to navigate through result pages.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page.

date_to.description: Filter messages sent up to this date. Unix timestamp format (seconds since epoch).

operator.description: Logical operator for multiple search filters. Use 'AND' to match all filters or 'OR' to match any filter.

order_by.description: Sort results by field. Format: field:asc or field:desc (e.g., 'date:desc', 'status:asc').

date_from.description: Filter messages sent from this date onwards. Unix timestamp format (seconds since epoch).

CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND.description: Tool to send one or more SMS messages via ClickSend. Use when you need to send SMS messages to recipients. Supports up to 1000 messages per API call and provides detailed status for each message.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format with country code (e.g., '+61411111111'). Must include the '+' prefix and country code.

body.description: Message content/text to send. Standard message contains only GSM characters (max 160 chars). Unicode message contains characters outside GSM set (max 70 chars).

from.description: Sender identifier - can be a shared number, dedicated number, alpha tag (business name), or your own number. If not provided, uses default sender.

source.description: Message source identifier for tracking purposes (e.g., 'sdk', 'php', 'api').

country.description: Destination country code for automatic country code addition to phone numbers.

list_id.description: Contact list identifier to send messages to contacts from your list. If provided, sends to all contacts in the specified list.

schedule.description: Unix timestamp for scheduled sending. If provided, message will be sent at the specified time instead of immediately.

from_email.description: Sender email address if sending via email-to-SMS.

custom_string.description: Custom reference string for tracking purposes. Can be used to associate the message with your internal systems.

items.description: Data model for a single SMS message.

messages.description: List of SMS messages to send. You can post up to 1000 messages with each API call. Each message must have 'to' and 'body' fields at minimum. The `to` field must be in full international format with '+' and country code (e.g., '+12025551234'). Optional `schedule` field accepts a Unix timestamp (seconds) to delay sending; omit to send immediately. Long or Unicode-heavy `body` values may be split into multiple SMS segments, affecting billing.

SAPERLY_SEND_SMS.description: PAID / METERED: send a single SMS from one of your Saperly numbers to an E.164 destination. This SPENDS REAL MONEY and sends a REAL text message to a REAL phone (~2 cents per 160-character segment; a long body is split into multiple segments, each billed). TCPA CONSENT GATE (required): the API refuses to send unless the recipient has an active consent record (or messaged you within the last 24h). For cold outbound you MUST first call SAPERLY_RECORD_CONSENT for the destination, and you can verify it with SAPERLY_CHECK_CONSENT — otherwise this fails with 403 RecipientOptedOut / compliance. Before sending, confirm sufficient funds via SAPERLY_GET_USAGE (balanceCents). Pass idempotency_key to prevent a double-send on retry. Returns 201 with the queued message (id, status, segments). NOTE the response echoes the sending number as 'numberId' and 'from_number' (not 'fromNumberId'). Fails 402 (InsufficientFunds / SpendLimitExceeded), 400 (DestinationNotSupported / invalid request).

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format (leading '+', full international number), e.g. +14155550123.

examples: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 3pm.
body.description: The message text (1-1600 characters). Long messages are split into multiple 160-character segments and BILLED PER SEGMENT (~2c each).

fromNumberId.description: Id of the Saperly number to send FROM (from SAPERLY_LIST_NUMBERS). Must be a number owned by the connected workspace and within the key's number allow-list. NOTE: the API echoes this back as 'numberId' in the response.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. The same key plus the same body replays the same result instead of sending again — pass it on retries to prevent double-sending and double-charging.

CLICKSEND_SMS_HISTORY_EXPORT_GET.description: Tool to export all SMS message history to a CSV file. Downloads a complete export of your SMS history. Use when you need to download all historical SMS messages for analysis, reporting, backup, or archival purposes. Note: This exports all SMS history without filtering - use 'Get SMS History' action first if you need to filter by date, status, or other criteria before deciding to export.

filename.description: Filename to download SMS history as (e.g., 'sms_history_export.csv')
